meta.name: alterlab-etetoolkit
meta.description: Manipulate, annotate, and render phylogenetic trees programmatically with the ETE Toolkit (ete3) — parse and edit Newick/NHX, detect duplication/speciation events, infer orthology and paralogy, query NCBI taxonomy, and export PDF/SVG figures. Use when traversing or reformatting tree files, doing phylogenomic comparative analysis, or producing publication tree graphics in Python. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 解析、注释和渲染系统发育树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Python中处理系统发育树文件并生成出版级图表。
copy.tagline_en: Parse, annotate, and render phylogenetic trees
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manipulate phylogenetic tree files and produce publication-quality figures in Python.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 ETE Toolkit 处理进化树：读取 Newick 等格式，修剪、重定根、检测基因重复/物种分化事件，推断直系/旁系同源，查询 NCBI 分类，并导出 PDF/SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你需要解析或编辑进化树文件（如 Newick/NHX）、进行系统发育比较分析、或生成出版级树图时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 tree.nw 文件加载进化树，然后修剪掉物种A、B、C以外的分支。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并执行修剪操作。

say.text: 用这个基因树检测重复事件，并推断直系同源基因。
say.note: Claude 会运行重复/物种分化检测。

say.text: 把进化树导出为 PDF，圆形布局，按支持度着色。
say.note: Claude 会生成可视化文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ETE Toolkit to manipulate phylogenetic trees: parse Newick/NHX, prune, reroot, detect duplication/speciation events, infer orthology/paralogy, query NCBI taxonomy, and export PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to parse or edit tree files (e.g., Newick/NHX), perform phylogenomic comparative analysis, or produce publication-quality tree graphics.

say_en.text: Load the tree from tree.nw and prune all branches except species A, B, and C.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and perform pruning.

say_en.text: Detect duplication events in this gene tree and infer orthologs.
Export the tree as PDF with circular layout and color by support.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the visualization file.
